Security and identity

Tokens, cryptography, SSRF protection and CAPTCHA, permission-based authorization on ASP.NET Identity, and contracts for signing keys, certificates and facial verification with their providers.

Packages

Package What it does Builds on
Security Core security library providing JWT token handling, cryptography utilities, ClaimsPrincipal extensions, the shared CAPTCHA contract, the certificate authentication and facial verification contracts, and SSRF protection for outbound HTTP. —
Security.AspNetCore Security configuration, authenticated user services and adaptive CAPTCHA verification for ASP.NET Core applications. Common, Security
Security.AspNetCore.Blazor Authentication state providers for Blazor applications with JWT and OIDC support, plus an adaptive CAPTCHA component. AspNetCore.Blazor, Common, Security
Security.Biometrics.Serpro SERPRO Datavalid implementation of the NuvTools.Security facial verification contract: a capture is matched against the face on government record for a CPF. Common, Security, Validation
Security.Certificate.Lacuna Lacuna REST PKI implementation of the NuvTools.Security certificate authentication contract: possession of the private key and the ICP-Brasil chain are validated on the service. Common, Security
Security.Signing.Azure Azure Key Vault implementation of the NuvTools.Security signing key contract: tokens are signed by a key that never leaves the vault, and a rotated key is picked up without a restart. Security
Security.Identity Permission-based authorization with dynamic policy provider and claim-based permission handler for ASP.NET Identity. Security
Security.Identity.AspNetCore ASP.NET Core user management service with email confirmation, password management, and role administration for ASP.NET Identity. Common, Security, Security.Identity.Models
Security.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore Entity Framework Core identity persistence with transaction management and batch operations for ASP.NET Identity. Data.EntityFrameworkCore
Security.Identity.Models ASP.NET Identity base models, form DTOs, and API models with localized validation for user and role management. Resources, Validation
